context: Hybrid fullstack asset management workspace for campus operations
design_direction: Wope-inspired research cockpit: illuminated violet accents, structured data density, calm long-session ergonomics, and an explicit light/dark theme system. Do not copy Wope branding or assume visual preferences beyond the requested reference.

primary_tasks: assign, check out, and check in assets
move an asset through maintenance/status workflows
verify every action in activity logs
success_actions: complete an assignment or check-in without ambiguity
filter inventory to a useful result in under one interaction cycle
open an asset detail and understand its current owner, status, and history
export or inspect a trustworthy report
see a corresponding persisted log for every mutation
discovery.emotional_tone: confident, precise, calm, operational; a control room rather than a flashy SaaS landing page
discovery.theme: support light and dark modes from the first render; persist preference and respect prefers-color-scheme

descriptors: clear product navigation with visible Pricing, Download, Contact and auth actions
feature sections built around detailed research views and track tables
contrast by illumination rather than heavy shadows
data visualization supports hierarchy and scanning
search and filtering reduce operational complexity

research.translation: Borrow the illuminated contrast, spacious hierarchy, and research-table clarity; translate them to campus asset workflows with stronger status semantics, auditability, and accessibility.

heading.usage: page titles, section headings, metric values

mono.usage: asset IDs, serials, timestamps, audit event IDs

rules: body text-sm on dense tables and text-base on detail pages
do not use Inter, Roboto, Open Sans, or Lato for headings

colors.archetype: Swiss and high-contrast with an illuminated violet accent, constrained to functional actions and active states
rules: primary violet is reserved for CTAs, active navigation, focus and selected rows
all status colors must have text/icon labels in addition to color
use contrast-safe foregrounds; target WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 for normal text

visual_enhancers.texture: very subtle CSS noise/grain at low opacity, aria-hidden, never behind critical text
visual_enhancers.surfaces: solid tinted surfaces with 1px borders; optional backdrop-blur-xl only for sticky header and dialogs with non-transparent background
visual_enhancers.depth: border contrast and restrained ambient shadow, not stacked floating cards
visual_enhancers.radius: rounded-xl for surfaces, rounded-full for compact controls and badges
visual_enhancers.scrollbar: custom narrow scrollbar using tinted track/thumb; no layout gutter
visual_enhancers.iconography: lucide-react, consistent 16/18px stroke icons; never emoji icons

layouts.app_shell: desktop: fixed left rail 248px plus content; mobile: Sheet navigation; top bar has breadcrumb, global search, theme toggle, notifications and profile
layouts.dashboard: high-density grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-4/6; summary metrics span 1; primary trend chart spans 2 and 2 rows; activity feed spans 1 and 2 rows
layouts.inventory: toolbar above a dense table; sticky table header; filters in a Sheet/Popover; detail opens as route or wide Sheet; preserve query state in URL
layouts.detail: asymmetric two-column desktop layout: identity and lifecycle timeline left, current assignment/actions and metadata right; mobile stacks with actions first
layouts.reports: metric strip, chart region, table region, export controls; never rely on chart color alone
layouts.spacing: use p-6/p-8 for bordered surfaces and py-12/py-16 between major sections; avoid cramped p-4 unless dense table cells

rules: use h-full for neighboring dashboard widgets
do not fill every cell if an empty offset improves scanning
tables align numeric columns right and text columns left

navigation: sidebar links: Dashboard, Inventory, Assignments, Maintenance, Reports, Activity Logs
desktop links visible; mobile navigation uses Sheet
active link uses violet rail/accent and explicit text color
components.theme: Switch with sun/moon icons, data-testid=theme-toggle-button; never use a transparent dropdown or dialog surface

auth: Google sign-in button with loading, error, and success states
functional_ui_contract.activity_logging: Every successful mutation writes one database activity event containing actorId, action, entityType, entityId, before snapshot or relevant previous value, after snapshot or relevant new value, timestamp, and metadata. Failed mutations do not create success logs; optionally write a failed-attempt event only if explicitly labeled failed.
reliability: optimistic UI only for reversible visual states; server is source of truth
refresh affected asset, counts and activity feed after mutation
prevent duplicate submissions with request IDs or disabled state
functional_ui_contract.sample_data: Use realistic seeded campus assets and activity logs, clearly label seed/demo data in development; do not present mocked Google auth or API data as production-ready.

motion.entrance: stagger rows/cards by 30-50ms with opacity and translateY only
motion.interaction: transition-colors, transform, opacity, box-shadow with 150-220ms ease; never transition-all
motion.selection: selected table row gets tinted surface and left accent
motion.reduced_motion: @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) disables stagger, parallax and nonessential transforms

requirements: keyboard reachable navigation, tables, dialogs and menus
announce toast/errors with Sonner or aria-live
do not rely on hover-only information
accessibility.testing: Every button, link, input, menu trigger, tab, row action, key metric, error, confirmation and balance/count must include stable kebab-case data-testid such as asset-inventory-search-input, asset-row-checkout-button, activity-log-event-row.

media.image_policy: No imagery is required for the core authenticated workspace. Prefer data, iconography and subtle grain over stock photos. Do not add placeholder image URLs.
media.responsive: Any optional asset thumbnails use max-h-[80vh] md:max-h-none and object-contain; preserve alt text.

3d_libraries.reason: Asset operations prioritize clarity, speed and auditability; 3D would distract from dense workflows.

implementation_steps: Define CSS variables for both themes in /app/frontend/src/index.css using tinted neutrals and the palette above
replace default system heading treatment with Manrope and IBM Plex Sans/Mono via a local or approved web font import
build the shared shell and theme persistence before pages
implement Inventory table and asset detail first because they anchor all workflows
wire every mutation to the API and activity log transaction
add dashboard/report aggregates from persisted data, not hardcoded counts
add auth route guards and Google/email states
add loading, empty, error and success states
run keyboard, responsive, dark/light and reduced-motion checks
verify every interactive and key informational element has data-testid
instructions_to_main_agent: Implement in JavaScript/JSX files, not TSX. Use existing shadcn primitives in /app/frontend/src/components/ui and customize them rather than recreating dialogs, selects, calendars or toasts. Use Sonner for notifications. Do not use transparent headers, overlays or dropdown surfaces. Keep desktop navigation links visible. Avoid centered app containers, generic blue gradients, excessive cards, emoji icons, and universal transition rules.
GENERAL_UI_UX_DESIGN_GUIDELINES: Every page has visible brand/navigation context and a clear primary action
Every mutation has pending, success and error states
Every action that changes server state produces one accurate persisted activity log
Use generous spacing around sections but dense readable table cells
Keep text left-aligned for operational content; center only compact metrics when useful
Use color as a supplement to labels and icons
Do not hide critical controls behind hover
Never use placeholders for missing data in production UI; show explicit empty states
Use realistic sample data only as clearly identified seed data
Test light and dark themes on every page
All interactive and key informational elements must include data-testid
